H01.description: Passes `config or {}` to _update_class_schema because _get_typed_dict_config may now return None; mechanical consequence of the D2 fix.

H02.description: For a stdlib dataclass without __pydantic_config__, head pushes an empty config {} onto the config stack, which overrides the parent's config instead of inheriting it as core schema generation does.

H03.description: Passes `config or {}` to _update_class_schema because the dataclass config may now be None; follows from the D1 fix.

H04.description: Changes the return annotation to ConfigDict | None and adds a comment, to go with the D2 return-value fix.

H05.description: _get_typed_dict_config returns {} when a typed dict has no config, so pushing it overrides the parent's config instead of inheriting it as core schema generation does.

I01.description: Class config (including json_schema_mode_override) is pushed inside the dataclass/typed-dict schema methods, i.e. after generate_inner's definitions cache lookup, so nested schemas can be cached under the wrong mode.
